Envelope approach

Mineral-wool cavities, exterior insulation, interior air/vapour control and a drained rainscreen remain an unvalidated proposal. The displayed plywood is structural sheathing, not a finished weather barrier. Roof falls, moisture, thermal bridges, fire and ventilation require coordinated design.
